description: Create a human approval request before paying (or any risky action). Returns approveUrl to show your human, agentToken and statusUrl. Needs X-API-Key on the MCP connection (monthly plan includes 20/day; credits: 3); without a key use HTTP POST https://approve.moneytools.dev/v1/approvals with x402 ($0.003). [served by approve.moneytools.dev]

amountUsd.description: Amount in USD the human approves (upper bound)

details.description: Extra context for the human (max 1000 chars)

notify.description: { webhook?: https URL (signed POST), email?: address (limited availability), telegramChatId?: string (not enabled yet) }

title.description: What the agent wants to do, e.g. 'Pay api.example.com 0.50 USDC for a report'

name: approval_request
title: Ask your human to approve a payment
